fee_notes: Royalty Fee is 5% of Gross Room Revenues; may be reduced at franchisor discretion for qualifying franchisees. Program Fee (marketing/brand fund) is currently 3% of Gross Room Revenues, may increase up to 0.5% per 12-month period, capped at 5.5%. Reservation Fee is currently 1% of Gross Room Revenues, may increase up to 0.5% per 12-month period, capped at 2%. IT Services Fee is $400/month plus $4.00 per Authorized Guest Room per month. PMS Software Fee is $4.00 per Authorized Guest Room per month. Online Subscription Fee (Training) is $800-$1,200 annually. Portal Access Fee is $3-$5 per user per month. Direct Connect Service/Channel Fees are $1.50-$2.50 per reservation. Motel-specific PPP/Microsite Fee: $299 set-up + $499 annually; Professional Property Photos $699 single brand or $999 dual brands; Content Translation $199 set-up + $99 annually. Sales360 Program Fee is $1,200/month (optional).
